notes.title: Light version, version down
notes.notes: A translation defect was found in the light version 1.01, so it was returned to the light version 1.00.

notes.title: Light version
notes.notes:
A light version has been released. 
The forest level and some objects have been cut.
The light version installation requires 4 GB of storage.
Right click on the game name in the Steam app and press Properties.
Select light-version from the drop down list on the Beta tab. 
To undo, select "None. not participate in any beta".
